findings.description: Counter (src/Counter.sol#18-127) declares permission `beforeAddLiquidity` (bit 11, BEFORE_ADD_LIQUIDITY_FLAG) but provides no working `beforeAddLiquidity` implementation. The PoolManager will call it on every matching pool operation and the call will revert, making the pool unusable for that operation.
evidence: Counter (src/Counter.sol#18-127) declares permission `beforeAddLiquidity` (bit 11, BEFORE_ADD_LIQUIDITY_FLAG) but provides no working `beforeAddLiquidity` implementation. The PoolManager will call it on every matching pool operation and the call will revert, making the pool unusable for that operation.

findings.title: Counter (src/Counter.sol#18-127) declares custom-accounting permissions: `beforeSwapReturnDelta` (bit 3)
findings.description: Counter (src/Counter.sol#18-127) declares custom-accounting permissions: `beforeSwapReturnDelta` (bit 3). The hook can alter settled amounts, which raises its risk tier under the framework's custom-math and price-impact triggers and means differential output comparison (invariant I2) does not apply — the harness substitutes price monotonicity.
evidence: Counter (src/Counter.sol#18-127) declares custom-accounting permissions: `beforeSwapReturnDelta` (bit 3). The hook can alter settled amounts, which raises its risk tier under the framework's custom-math and price-impact triggers and means differential output comparison (invariant I2) does not apply — the harness substitutes price monotonicity.

evidence: A returns-delta permission lets the hook alter settled amounts, which is the framework’s definition of price-impacting behaviour.
